_description: Task13 WEIGHTING field, COARSE transcription -- the 0.55mm far-field grid for the 5x5 LArPix v2a tile at the true 4.4mm pitch. The fine sibling (example_gen_pixel_with_grid_task13_fine.json) carries the true design values unsnapped. This file models the SAME PHYSICAL PAD as example_gen_pcb_drift_pixel_task13_coarse.json at the same spacing; the pad keys in the two files are identical on purpose and must be edited together. PHASE 4 RETARGET: this file was the 0.22mm / 79.15mm transcription. Two measurements moved it (scripts/NOTES-run-pixel-field-seam.md): 0.22mm was far too fine for the bulk, because the far field is essentially 1-D linear out there and linear fields are exact on ANY spacing; and the near/far interface at 19.8mm was measured sitting INSIDE the corrugated zone FOR THIS FIELD -- transverse corrugation was 40% of the local W on the seam plane, against 7e-08 for the drift field -- which no number of Schwarz sweeps can fix, because the sweep converges the two domains to each other, not to the truth. The interface moves out to 29.7mm and the coarse grid relaxes to 0.55mm. NO CathodePotential AND NO GridPotential IN THIS FILE, AND DO NOT ADD THEM. The weighting potential is a DIMENSIONLESS UNIT PROBE in [0,1]: the collecting pixel is held at 1 and every other electrode, the cathode included, at 0. The drift pair's cathode formula (-BulkField * drift length) does not apply here, and the drift pair's new 50.0 V/mm design field has no counterpart in this file. driftZDepth 149.55 is carried only so the file handed to induce-pixel is not stale; the weighting solve does not use a drift length. 1.1mm IS THE SHARED PERIOD of the 0.55mm and 0.1mm grids -- the two grids share nodes only every 1.1mm -- and every plane that must land on both is a whole multiple of it: pitch 4.4 = 4x1.1 (8 coarse / 44 fine cells), pad plane 9.9 = 9x1.1 (18 / 99), interface 29.7 = 27x1.1 (54 / 297), cathode 149.6 = 136x1.1 (272 / 1496). TRANSVERSE EXTENT: Npixels 5 at the 4.4mm pitch = 22.0mm, which is 40 coarse cells at this file's 0.55mm spacing (it was 100 at 0.22mm) and 220 fine cells. Unlike the drift field, the weighting probe is solved NON-PERIODIC over the whole 5x5 tile -- edges fix,fix,fix -- so Npixels DOES size this file's domain. SNAPPED PAD/GAP: the design values are pixelSize 3.5, pixelGap 0.9, chamfer_r 0.7, preserved as the _design_* keys below (the generators ignore _design_* keys). gcd(35,9) = 1, so NO spacing coarser than 0.1mm divides both the pad and the gap exactly and some snapping on the coarse grid is unavoidable. CELL COUNTS AT 0.55mm: pixelSize 3.30 -> 6 cells, pixelGap 1.10 -> 2 cells, chamfer_r 0.55 -> 1 cell. PITCH MUST STAY EXACTLY 4.4mm = 8 coarse cells: 6 + 2 = 8. hybrid_iterate.py _cells() requires the transverse extent to be a WHOLE number of cells and raises otherwise. padThickness and FR4Thickness are both 0.55 so each rounds to exactly ONE cell: the generator derives pp_width = n_pad + n_fr4 - 1 = 1, putting the coarse pad TOP at (18+1)*0.55 = 10.45mm against the fine grid's 10.00mm. (1) THE COARSE PAD AREA IS 11.1% SMALL, AND IT MATTERS MORE HERE THAN FOR DRIFT. (3.30/4.4)^2 = 0.5625 against the fine grid's (3.5/4.4)^2 = 0.6327, i.e. -11.1%. (Note: 0.6327, not the 0.6332 quoted in some earlier notes -- (3.5/4.4)^2 is 0.632748, which makes the snap cost -11.1% rather than -11.2%.) The DRIFT far field is set by the cathode against the pad PLANE and is largely insensitive to pad detail; the WEIGHTING far tail instead scales roughly WITH PAD AREA, so an 11.1% small coarse pad plausibly biases far W by about the same fraction. That bias lands in the output: the far field in the final stitched volume IS the upsampled coarse solution, and it is a SMOOTH error the Laplacian residual metric cannot detect. This is the accepted price of relaxing the bulk grid from 0.22mm to 0.55mm. IT IS AN EXPECTATION, NOT A MEASUREMENT -- to be measured in Phase 4/Step 7. Do not quote it as a result. (2) THE FAR TAIL IS ALREADY UNPHYSICAL, FOR AN UNRELATED AND KNOWN REASON. This was confirmed by measurement (pochoir-h92v), not inferred: the transverse edges fix,fix,fix are implemented as a NEUMANN MIRROR, not a Dirichlet zero (fdm_generic.py:8-34 -- the 'fixed' branch copies from the interior), so the 5x5 patch behaves as an INFINITE PERIODIC PAD ARRAY. W was measured falling essentially LINEARLY to zero from z ~ 30mm out to the cathode -- the parallel-plate signature -- instead of decaying as an isolated pad's weighting potential would. So the entire far side of this solve has an unphysical tail. This is a KNOWN OPEN DEFECT of the weighting solve. It is NOT fixed here and is NOT to be fixed in this step. Note that it compounds with (1): both corrupt the far amplitude, and a Step 7 measurement of the pad-area bias must not be read as if the BC were correct. NO MEASURED NUMBERS SURVIVE FROM THE 8cm TRANSCRIPTION. Every such figure -- the '100 cells at this file's 0.22mm spacing', the '~38 M node' grid size, the with-grid-vs-without far-W ratios (6.4x at 25mm and the rest), the 10.12mm coarse pad top -- has been DELETED rather than carried over, because none of it transfers: different depth, different spacing, different pad snap, different interface. Do not reinstate any of it, and do not write a new number here until it has actually been solved for. Recorded-but-unverified docstring facts have already gone stale twice in this repo. WHAT MUST AGREE BETWEEN THE FILES, precisely: it is the FINE pair -- this field's fine config and the drift field's fine config -- that must agree about the pad surface, because both fields' NEAR solves and ALL drift paths live on the 0.1mm grid, where the pad top is 10.00mm in both. Each COARSE file only supplies the far field beyond the 29.7mm interface, where the pad's discretisation no longer shapes the geometry, only the far amplitude. (Both fields do happen to share the 0.55mm coarse spacing here, so the two coarse files also agree -- but that is a coincidence of this geometry, not the reason it matters.) pixelPlaneWidth 0.55 is INERT in this configuration and is kept only in step with the spacing for readability: with enableInsulatorFR4 true and both padThickness and FR4Thickness present, the generator DERIVES pp_width and overwrites whatever this key says. SHIELD GRID OFF (GridHoleShape 'None'): inherited from the older with-grid task13 work and never intended here -- the LArPix v2a 5x5 tile is a WOGRID geometry in production (commits a3d5e2c, 413460d). PcbWidth and HoleRadius are inert and left in place: with 'None' neither the circular nor the square branch runs. THE test/ COPIES NOW DIVERGE FURTHER. The four task13 configs under scripts/ are retargeted to this geometry; their same-named copies in test/ are NOT, and test/run-task13-hybrid.sh still solves an older geometry. The cmp recipe in run-pixel-field.sh's header will report all four pairs as differing; that is expected, not a mistake to 'fix' by copying either way.
